description: Ministry of Sports - Amended the Sections 13 and 17 of the Regulations published on National Sports Associations No. 1 of 2013 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1793/03 of 15.01.2013
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending sections 13 and 17 of existing regulations. It involves legal/regulatory matters - amendments to existing regulations, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters, including statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation. While it mentions a Minister's name, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify for Types 1-3.
